info.text:
The cheapest health plan can cost you more: in our hypothetical example, a low-premium high-deductible plan saves $1,200 in a quiet year but costs $800 more in a $40,000 surgery year. This step-by-step guide covers the 2027 enrollment deadlines (HealthCare.gov open enrollment runs Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027; Dec 15 was the deadline for Jan 1 coverage; HHS is appealing a June 2026 court ruling that kept the longer window), the five numbers in every plan, network types, and how to add up premiums, expected costs and the worst case. It also covers the 2027 out-of-pocket cap ($12,000 self-only / $24,000 family), 2027 HSA limits ($4,500 / $9,000), bronze and catastrophic plans becoming HSA-eligible in 2026, metal tiers and the most common mistakes. All plans shown are hypothetical examples.

News and education, not financial advice.
